objective: Prevent non-OWNER settings visits from issuing OWNER-only runtime-config reads before UI permission gating.
requirement_gap: DOC-D config panel is OWNER-only and packages/api/live-config authorizes GET/POST/rollback only for OWNER. Current SettingsPage runs GET /api/config in a parent useEffect before returning PermissionGate, so OPERATOR/AUDITOR visits still issue a known-forbidden privileged read.
success_invariants: OPERATOR/AUDITOR settings visits do not mount GET /api/config
